text:
Ivy (Growth): Kickoff — we're doing a 28-minute "micro-lab" aimed at EMEA+APAC. Key asks: ultra-tight run-of-show, explicit fallback scripts for demos, and a clear lead playbook. Can we lock this today?
Samira - Events: Love "micro-lab" name. Proposed structure: 2m intro, 9m demo A, 9m demo B, 6m moderated Q&A + CTA = 26m; add 2m buffer. Require recorded fallbacks for both demos and a short hosted slide deck.
Ken (Design): I'll build a 4-slide demo template (hook / steps / screenshot / CTA). Also creating a one-line speaker prompt to paste into the host view so moderators can cut to the fallback quickly.
Vik (Eng Ops): For leads: registration should capture "deployment_interest" (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) + "current_monthly_inference_spend" (<$1k, $1-5k, $5-20k, >$20k) + hidden "workload_type" param. Map to SFDC campaign = microlab_ema_apac_2026.
Ivy (Growth): Add a priority rule: if spend >= $5-20k OR >$20k -> tag = "high_value" and send immediate Slack ping to #sdr-apac-emea, otherwise normal queue. Also capture demo_choice so ops can route to right SE.
Vik (Eng Ops): Will implement via Zapier -> SFDC -> Salesforce Assignment Rule. I'll also add a mid-tier SLA: high_value -> 6h, mid -> 24h, low -> 72h. I'll post the field mapping doc after this thread.
Samira - Events: Greenroom ops: need an explicit fallback script block per demo: when to switch to recorded clip, what the moderator says, what chat message to paste. Can @GreenroomBot schedule these cues?
GreenroomBot: Affirmative. I will post the following automated cues to the channel: T-48h rehearsal, T-30m mic check, T-10 switch-to-speaker, T-2 start-recording, T+30s post resource deck link, T+1m post survey. I can also post the fallback script at T-5m.
Ken (Design): Fallback script sample I suggest we use (copy/paste-ready):

"Moderator: We're seeing a hiccup with the live demo. We're switching to a short recorded clip that shows the same flow; we'll return to live in a moment. In the meantime, please drop questions in chat and we'll cover them during Q&A."

We'll also have a 90s recorded clip per demo named: demoA_fallback_90s.mp4, demoB_fallback_90s.mp4.
Ivy (Growth): Love the script. For chat copy during fallback: include the survey link and the triage form link so high-value attendees can request a meeting immediately. Example chat: "If this is a priority for you, click: https://redwood.com/triage?utm=microlab and we'll route you within 6h."
Vik (Eng Ops): I'll add a hidden form field triage_priority that maps to the SFDC "Priority" field so SDRs can sort. Also we should log demo_fallback_used boolean on lead record for handoff context.
Samira - Events: Rehearsal schedule: full-dress 48h prior (35m), tech check 20m prior, last-minute cue check 10m prior. Proposed rehearsal slots: Wed 01:00 UTC, Fri 08:00 UTC. I'll send calendar invites.
Ken (Design): Need 50-word bios and any one-sentence highlight metrics for slides.
Ivy (Growth): Bios: "Tanya (Platform) - Tanya leads Redwood's platform product; focuses on inference efficiency and model-serving reliability, with a background in systems engineering." "Ravi (Customer) - Ravi leads ML infra at RetailCo; reduced inference cost by 3x in production." Moderator copy: "Ivy - Growth" will introduce and keep time.
Vik (Eng Ops): Oncall plan: Tanya will keep a 10-min standby for the demo window; if infra fails, switch to the recorded clip and open a private incident DM channel: #webinar-incident-5223456789 for real-time triage.
Samira - Events: I'll pin the run-of-show (Drive link) and the exact filenames for fallback clips. Also will prepare a single-slide resource card with the triage CTA, sample benchmark, and link to docs.
Ivy (Growth): Final owner list: Samira (events + greenroom), Vik (lead routing + SLA + mapping), Ken (slides + fallback clips), Ivy (moderator + copy + panel). Let's reconfirm rehearsal RSVPs by EOD.
Ken (Design): I'll drop slide draft + fallback clip names by EOD tomorrow.
Vik (Eng Ops): I'll post the SFDC field mapping and the Zapier recipe here after lunch.
Samira - Events: Thanks everyone 83c. I'll upload run-of-show now and schedule rehearsals.
